verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a Browser capability that opens websites, gathers current information, and takes action while the user stays in control. They say it can 'complete a multi-step task on a website', and it can work in a signed-in open tab, across Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, or Vivaldi, and with website-offered Site tools (WebMCP), with admin controls for browser use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agentic browser task completion (the only community mention refers to the older browsing plugin).
